title: 计算器
description: 支持运算优先级、键盘输入、百分比与计算历史的日常计算器。
html:
EVERYDAY TOOLS

计算器轻松算，专心想。

从日常小账到灵感中的数字，随手计算。

⌨ 支持键盘输入
标准计算● READY
0
输入数字，开始计算

↺ 计算历史

点击记录，继续使用结果

记录保存在此浏览器
Enter 计算结果Esc 全部清空⌫ 删除一位遵循先乘除、后加减
css: .calc-page{--cc-text:#edf4fa;--cc-muted:#91a2b9;--cc-accent:#75e2c0;max-width:960px;margin:0 auto;padding:clamp(20px,4vw,48px) clamp(12px,3vw,32px);color:var(--cc-text);font-family:Inter,-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,'Segoe UI','PingFang SC',sans-serif}.calc-page *{box-sizing:border-box}.calc-heading{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:20px;margin-bottom:30px}.calc-eyebrow{color:var(--cc-accent);font-size:10px;letter-spacing:2.4px;font-weight:700;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;margin-bottom:14px}.calc-eyebrow span{width:6px;height:6px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--cc-accent)}.calc-heading h1{font-size:32px;letter-spacing:-1px;line-height:1.3;margin:0 0 10px;font-weight:650}.calc-heading h1 span{font-size:14px;letter-spacing:0;font-weight:400;color:var(--cc-muted);margin-left:18px}.calc-heading p{font-size:13px;line-height:1.6;color:var(--cc-muted);margin:0}.calc-badge{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;white-space:nowrap;font-size:12px;color:#a9bacd;padding:9px 12px;border:1px solid #283548;border-radius:8px;background:#121d2c}.calc-layout{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1.4fr) minmax(245px,1fr);gap:20px;align-items:stretch}.calc-main{min-width:0;background:#121c2b;border:1px solid #2b3a4e;border-radius:22px;overflow:hidden;box-shadow:0 20px 60px #0003}.calc-display{padding:23px 27px 19px;background:radial-gradient(ellipse at top right,#18362f66,transparent 80%),#101a27;text-align:right;min-height:193px;border-bottom:1px solid #283547}.calc-display-top{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;color:#a6b6c8;font-size:11px;margin-bottom:23px}.calc-live{font-size:9px;letter-spacing:1.5px;color:#80baa8}.calc-expression{font-size:14px;min-height:23px;color:#9db1c5;white-space:nowrap;overflow-x:auto;scrollbar-width:thin;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;line-height:1.6}.calc-result{display:block;width:100%;font-size:clamp(29px,4vw,48px);font-weight:450;letter-spacing:-1.7px;line-height:1.3;overflow-x:auto;white-space:nowrap;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;scrollbar-width:thin}.calc-status{min-height:18px;margin-top:9px;color:#8ea395;font-size:11px;line-height:1.5}.calc-controls{padding:16px}.calc-page button{font-family:inherit;cursor:pointer;-webkit-tap-highlight-color:transparent;transition:background .15s,transform .12s,border-color .15s}.calc-page button:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #a7f3d7;outline-offset:3px}.calc-utilities{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:9px;margin-bottom:12px}.calc-utilities button{height:36px;background:#152334;border:1px solid #29394c;border-radius:9px;color:#a9bcd1;font-size:14px}.calc-keypad{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,minmax(0,1fr));gap:9px}.calc-keypad button{height:58px;background:#1d2a3c;border:1px solid #2b3a4e;border-radius:11px;color:#e9f1fa;font-size:22px;line-height:1;font-weight:450}.calc-keypad .calc-function{background:#263348;color:#b4c6db;font-size:21px}.calc-keypad .calc-clear{background:#363044;border-color:#4b3f55;color:#e1bcce;font-size:17px}.calc-keypad .calc-operator{background:#203e3c;border-color:#30534b;color:#99e8ce;font-size:25px}.calc-keypad .calc-equals{background:#8ae7c8;border-color:#8ae7c8;color:#10342d;font-size:27px;box-shadow:0 3px 13px #75e2c020}.calc-keypad button:hover,.calc-utilities button:hover{filter:brightness(1.17)}.calc-keypad button:active,.calc-utilities button:active{transform:scale(.95)}.calc-side{min-width:0;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background:linear-gradient(155deg,#142031,#101a28);border:1px solid #26354a;border-radius:22px;padding:25px 22px 19px}.calc-history-heading{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px}.calc-history-heading h2{font-size:14px;font-weight:550;margin:0}.calc-history-heading h2 span{font-size:20px;vertical-align:-1px;color:#97b6bc;margin-right:5px}.calc-history-heading button{font-size:11px;padding:6px 9px;border:1px solid #334156;border-radius:6px;background:transparent;color:#a8b7ca}.calc-history-heading button:hover{background:#263548}.calc-history-note{font-size:11px;color:#91a2b9;margin:9px 0 20px}.calc-history{min-height:245px;flex:1;max-height:433px;overflow-y:auto;scrollbar-width:thin}.calc-history:empty:before{content:'暂无计算记录';display:block;text-align:center;color:#93a4b9;padding-top:105px;font-size:13px}.calc-history:empty:after{content:'完成一次计算，结果会出现在这里';display:block;text-align:center;color:#788ba4;margin-top:10px;font-size:11px}.calc-history button{display:block;width:100%;text-align:right;padding:14px 12px;background:transparent;border:0;border-bottom:1px solid #26374a;border-radius:8px;color:#eef6fc;overflow-wrap:anywhere}.calc-history button:hover{background:#203148}.calc-history button>*{display:block;line-height:1.6}.calc-history button>*:first-child{color:#96abc2;font-size:12px}.calc-history button>*:last-child{color:#b4edda;font-size:22px;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}.calc-side-footer{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:7px;border-top:1px solid #29374a;padding-top:17px;margin-top:20px;font-size:10px;color:#91a2b9}.calc-dot{width:5px;height:5px;border-radius:50%;background:#769b8d}.calc-footer{display:flex;align-items:center;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:18px;margin-top:20px;color:#8b9db3;font-size:10px}.calc-footer>span{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:7px}.calc-footer kbd{border:1px solid #344256;border-bottom-width:2px;border-radius:4px;min-width:23px;text-align:center;padding:3px 5px;color:#b7c7d9;font-family:inherit;font-size:10px}.calc-footer .calc-priority{margin-left:auto;color:#7d92ab}@media(min-width:1400px){.calc-page{padding-top:58px}}@media(max-width:660px){.calc-layout{grid-template-columns:1fr}.calc-heading{align-items:flex-start}.calc-badge{display:none}.calc-heading h1 span{display:block;margin:9px 0 0;font-size:13px}.calc-heading h1{font-size:28px}.calc-history{min-height:120px;max-height:240px}.calc-history:empty:before{padding-top:25px}.calc-side{padding:20px}.calc-footer .calc-priority{margin-left:0;width:100%}.calc-keypad button{height:59px}.calc-page{padding-top:24px}.calc-result{font-size:44px}}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.calc-page button{transition:none}}
